title.en: skate at somerset house, evening session.

line.en: the rink in the central courtyard runs until 10 january, with late sessions and djs. book a 45-minute slot; a wednesday evening is quieter than the weekend.
line.de: die bahn im zentralen innenhof läuft bis 10. januar, mit späten sessions und djs. ein 45-minütiges zeitfenster buchen; ein mittwochabend ist ruhiger als das wochenende.
line.tr: merkez avludaki pist 10 ocak'a kadar açık, geç seanslar ve djler var. 45 dakikalık bir zaman seç; çarşamba akşamı hafta sonundan sakin.

sparks.why: Skate at Somerset House runs 11 Nov 2026 to 10 Jan 2027, with late DJ sessions per somersethouse.org.uk; the 2026 evening session times were not confirmed, so 18:00 is a suggested start.
